SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date, SUM(f.quantity) AS sold, COUNT(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.store_key=30 AND f.product_key=11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.store_key||'-'||fs.product_key) AS n_keys, MAX(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded
FROM fact_stock_week fs WHERE fs.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-20' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, fs.week_ending_date AS week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL
